record.issuing_body: Plurinational Legislative Assembly of Bolivia – Chamber of Senators (approved text), transmitted to the Chamber of Deputies for review
record.notes: The Chamber of Senators approved the text on 22 Oct 2025, and its President transmitted it the same day to the Chamber of Deputies under Article 163(5) of the Constitution; the Chamber received it on 29 Oct 2025. By note of 27 Apr 2026 a deputy asked the Chamber's President, under Article 117 of its General Rules, to reinstate ('reposición') the bill so that its treatment continues in the current legislative year; the Chamber lists it among bills under review. The bill also provides fiscal, financial and administrative incentives for AI research and innovation (Article 15), requires the Executive to regulate it within 90 days of publication and to amend Supreme Decree No. 2514 of 9 Sep 2015, and gives AGETIC 180 days to issue technical guidelines and the national AI strategy.

verification.note: Recheck of 18 Oct 2026: re-read the Chamber of Deputies' scan of PL-CS-178-2024-2025 (read by OCR) and its listing of bills under review, both stored on 12 Oct 2026 from diputados.gob.bo and found unchanged by the archiver on 17 Oct 2026. The scan confirms the number and title, the Senate's text of 22 Oct 2025 with its 31 articles and two additional provisions, the transmittal note of 22 Oct 2025 (received 29 Oct 2025) and the reposición request of 27 Apr 2026; the listing shows the bill among bills under review. The sponsor's name (Sen. Claudia Egüez, Creemos) rested only on press reports (Correo del Sur, 23 Oct 2025; DPL News, 27 Oct 2025) that are not stored, so it was taken out of the issuing body. No later stage in the Chamber of Deputies (committee report or vote) appears in the stored files. The OCR text may contain minor character errors. No English version of the bill was found.

judgment.status_reasoning: The latest events in the stored files are the Senate's text of 22 Oct 2025 ('Remítase a la Camara de Diputados, para fines constitucionales de revisión'), its receipt by the Chamber of Deputies on 29 Oct 2025, and a deputy's request of 27 Apr 2026 to reinstate the bill for continued treatment in the current legislative year. The Chamber's listing (stored 12 Oct 2026, unchanged on 17 Oct 2026) shows it as 'Proyecto de Ley en Revisión'. No approval by the Chamber of Deputies or promulgation appears, so the bill is still 'Draft / proposed' with legal force 'Proposed'.
judgment.scope_reasoning: An AI-specific bill with prohibited practices, rights against solely automated decisions, transparency duties and a regulator; a pending bill is in scope with no note (unchanged).
